Tabora не&nbsp;загружает рекламные банне: Tabora doesn’t load ad banners or the trackers that follow you from site to site. Pages open faster, and you see only what you came for.
Работает сразу после установки: Works right after you install it
Включать и&nbsp;настраивать ничего не&nb: There’s nothing to turn on or set up. The browser updates its lists of ad addresses on its own.
Видно, что&nbsp;остановлено: You can see what was blocked

Бывает, что&nbsp;без&nbsp;рекламы сайт р: Sometimes a site doesn’t work properly without its ads. You can turn blocking off for just that site in one click. It stays on everywhere else.
Окна про&nbsp;cookie закрываются сами: Cookie pop-ups close on their own
Баннер «Мы&nbsp;используем cookie» брауз: The browser closes the “We use cookies” banner for you and chooses “Reject”.
Когда в&nbsp;ролике начинается реклама,: When an ad starts in a video, the browser runs through it in a couple of seconds, without sound, and doesn’t show it. No need to press “Skip”.

Браузер помнит пароли и&nbsp;коды входа: The browser remembers your passwords and sign-in codes
Пароли от&nbsp;сайтов и&nbsp;одноразовые: Your site passwords and one-time codes (the ones an app on your phone usually shows) are kept in the browser, protected by a single password of yours. On a site, you just click the suggestion.
Код появляется прямо под&nbsp;полем: The code appears right under the field
Когда сайт просит шестизначный код, брау: When a site asks for a six-digit code, the browser offers it. No need to reach for your phone.
Коды переносятся из&nbsp;телефона: Codes move over from your phone
Из&nbsp;Google Authenticator, Aegis и&nb: Codes from Google Authenticator, Aegis and 2FAS come over with a QR code. Passwords are imported as a file from another browser.
Он&nbsp;не&nbsp;отправляется на&nbsp;наш: It’s never sent to our servers, so even we can’t open your passwords and codes.
При&nbsp;создании аккаунта вы&nbsp;получ: When you create an account, you get a recovery key. Keep it somewhere safe: it will get you back in.
Пример: одноразовый код для GitHub с отс: Example: a one-time code for GitHub with a countdown and a saved password for bahn.de
Код скопирован, буфер очистится через 30: Code copied. The clipboard clears in 30 seconds
Почта с&nbsp;отдельным адресом для&nbsp;: Mail with a separate address for every site
Вместе с&nbsp;браузером вы&nbsp;получает: Along with the browser you get a mailbox like name@tabora.app. When a site asks for your email, the browser offers a separate address just for that site. Messages arrive in your mailbox, and the site never learns your real address.
Надоели рассылки? Выключите адрес: Tired of newsletters? Turn the address off
Сайт начал слать рекламу или&nbsp;переда: A site started sending you ads or passed your email on to someone else. Turn off the address you gave that site, and the messages stop coming.
Письма читаются и&nbsp;пишутся в&nbsp;бр: Read and write mail in the browser
Отдельная почтовая программа не&nbsp;нуж: You don’t need a separate mail app. You can also add the mailboxes you already have.
Письмо на&nbsp;другой адрес Tabora можно: A message to another Tabora address can be encrypted, so only the recipient can read it. The subject line stays unencrypted.
О&nbsp;новом письме скажет уведомление: A notification tells you about new mail
No need to check your mailbox by hand.
Те&nbsp;же&nbsp;пароли и&nbsp;закладки н: The same passwords and bookmarks on your second computer
Данные шифруются до&nbsp;отправки: Your data is encrypted before it’s sent
На&nbsp;сервере лежит копия, которую нел: The server holds a copy that can’t be read without your password. We can’t read it either.
Кошелёк остаётся на&nbsp;компьютере: The wallet stays on your computer
Секретная фраза кошелька не&nbsp;отправл: The wallet’s secret phrase is never sent anywhere.
видно, что&nbsp;открыто на&nbsp;другом к: see what’s open on your other computer
Кошелёк для&nbsp;криптовалюты в&nbsp;сам: A crypto wallet right in the browser
Кошелёк работает с&nbsp;Ethereum, Base,: The wallet works with Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Polygon, Bitcoin, Solana and TRON. The secret phrase is encrypted and kept only on your computer.
На&nbsp;биржах и&nbsp;в&nbsp;приложениях: On exchanges and in apps like Uniswap, just click “Connect”. You don’t need a separate extension.
Понятно, что&nbsp;вы&nbsp;подписываете: You can see what you’re signing
Перед подтверждением кошелёк показывает: Before you confirm, the wallet shows in plain words how much will leave, who gets it and what permissions the site will get. Risky requests are flagged.
USDT в&nbsp;разных сетях показан общей с: USDT on different networks is shown as one total. You pick the network when you send or receive.
Мошенники присылают копейки с&nbsp;адрес: Scammers send tiny amounts from an address that looks like yours, hoping you’ll copy it later by mistake. The wallet hides these transfers from your history.
Для&nbsp;разработчиков: EIP-6963 и&nbsp;: For developers: EIP-6963 and EIP-1193, Wallet Standard for Solana, TronLink compatibility. .eth names and ipfs:// links open from the address bar.
Пример окна подтверждения: сайт app.unis: Example of a confirmation window: app.uniswap.org asks you to sign a swap of 0.5 ETH for 1,702.40 USDC, and the recipient is your address
Агент заполнит форму и&nbsp;найдёт письм: The agent fills in forms and finds messages for you
Напишите агенту, что&nbsp;нужно сделать:: Tell the agent what you need: sign up on a site, find the message with a code, fill in a form. It does it in a browser tab while you watch.
Перед отправкой формы агент показывает,: Before submitting a form, the agent shows what will be sent and to which site. Nothing is sent without your OK.
Страница не&nbsp;может им командовать: A page can’t give it orders
Текст на&nbsp;сайте или&nbsp;в&nbsp;пись: Text on a site or in a message can’t make the agent do something behind your back: once it has read a page, every action it takes needs your confirmation.
Агенту нужен ваш ключ OpenAI. Ключ храни: The agent needs your OpenAI key. The key is stored in the browser, protected by your password.
Пример панели агента: по просьбе зарегис: Example of the agent panel: asked to sign up on bahn.de, the agent created a separate address, filled in the form and is asking permission to send it

Личное, Работа, Проекты. В&nbsp;каждом с: Personal, Work, Projects. Each has its own tabs, pinned sites and sign-ins: on the same site you can be in your work account in one space and your personal one in another.
Вкладки сбоку или&nbsp;сверху: Tabs on the side or on top
Список вкладок стоит слева и&nbsp;сворач: The tab list sits on the left and collapses to icons. If you’re used to tabs on top, turn them on in settings.
Ищет по&nbsp;открытым вкладкам и&nbsp;ис: It searches your open tabs and history, opens parts of the browser and takes tasks for the agent.
Вкладки, к&nbsp;которым вы&nbsp;давно не: Tabs you haven’t returned to in a while can be put to sleep so they don’t take up memory.
Вход можно закрыть вторым шагом (кодом и: You can protect sign-in with a second step (a code from an app) and add a backup email in case you forget your password.
Код открыт, его можно проверить: The code is open, so you can check it
Весь код Tabora опубликован на&nbsp;GitH: All of Tabora’s code is published on GitHub. You’ll also find the security review reports there, and a description of how passwords, mail and the wallet are protected.
Браузер установит только обновление, под: The browser installs only updates signed with Tabora’s key. The Mac installer is checked by Apple.
Страницы показывает движок Firefox. Испр: Pages are displayed by the Firefox engine. Security fixes arrive with its releases.
Код, который шифрует пароли и&nbsp;подпи: The code that encrypts passwords and signs transfers is built from open-source code at pinned versions. You can verify this with one command from the repository.

macOS&nbsp;11 или&nbsp;новее, процессоры: macOS 11 or later, M1 chips and later. Version 0.3.0. Free.
Аккаунт и&nbsp;почтовый ящик создаются в: You create your account and mailbox in the browser itself the first time you open it. Windows and Linux builds are on the way: watch the GitHub repository. Send questions to hello@tabora.app.

Tabora&nbsp;— бесплатный браузер с&nbsp;: Tabora is a free, open-source browser built on the Firefox engine. Firefox is a trademark of the Mozilla Foundation; Tabora is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mozilla.
На&nbsp;сайтах, где есть вход по&nbsp;кл: On sites that support passkeys you need no password: just confirm that it is you. Passkeys are kept next to your passwords.
Браузер сверит ваши пароли с&nbsp;базой: The browser compares your passwords with a database of stolen ones and shows which to change. The passwords themselves never leave your computer.
Войдите в&nbsp;свой аккаунт на&nbsp;друг: Sign in to your account on another computer, and your passwords, sign-in codes, bookmarks, history and the list of open tabs appear there.
Пароли, ключи доступа, коды, закладки, в: Passwords, passkeys, codes, bookmarks, tabs, history, addresses and settings are switched on one by one. Bank cards are synced only if you turn that on yourself. You can switch sync off and erase the copy from the server.
Страницу можно отправить на&nbsp;другое: Send a page to another device
Нашли статью на&nbsp;одном компьютере&nb: Found an article on one computer? Send it to another, and it opens there by itself.
страницы за&nbsp;два месяца: pages of the last two months
Группы вкладок и&nbsp;два сайта рядом: Tab groups and two sites side by side
Вкладки собираются в&nbsp;группы с&nbsp;: Tabs gather into groups with a name and a color. Two sites can be shown side by side in one window.
Закладки, история и&nbsp;пароли перенося: Bookmarks, history and passwords come over from Chrome, Safari, Edge and other browsers in a couple of clicks.
Поддержка в&nbsp;браузере и&nbsp;на&nbsp: Support in the browser and on the web
Вопрос или&nbsp;сообщение об ошибке отпр: Send a question or a bug report from the browser's settings or from support.tabora.app, with a screenshot if you like. On the site you can write even without an account.
Что Tabora знает о вас, где это хранится: What Tabora knows about you, where it is kept, who can see it and how to delete it all.
Браузер не следит за вами: не собирает с: The browser does not watch you: it collects no statistics and sends us no site addresses, search queries or page contents.
Пароли, коды входа, закладки, история и: Passwords, sign-in codes, bookmarks, history and tabs reach our server only encrypted. The key exists only on your devices, and we cannot read this data.
Почта хранится на нашем сервере, иначе е: Mail is kept on our server, otherwise it could not be delivered. We do not read it or use it for advertising.
Рекламы в Tabora нет, и данные мы никому: There are no ads in Tabora, and we sell data to no one.
Аккаунт можно удалить в любой момент: вс: You can delete the account at any moment: everything is erased at once.
История, закладки, сохранённые пароли, к: History, bookmarks, saved passwords, sign-in codes, wallet keys and settings are kept in the browser profile on your device. The password vault and the wallet are encrypted on disk.
Браузер не собирает статистику использов: The browser collects no usage statistics, sends no crash reports and has no advertising identifier.
Аккаунт состоит из адреса на tabora.app: An account is an address at tabora.app and a password. The account server keeps:
ваш адрес Tabora и дата создания аккаунт: your Tabora address and the date the account was created;
проверочное значение, вычисленное из пар: a check value computed from the password. The password itself never reaches the server and cannot be recovered from this value;
список ваших устройств: название, которо: the list of your devices: the name a device gave itself and the times of its first and latest sign-in;
секрет двухфакторной защиты и резервные: the two-step protection secret and backup codes, if you turned it on;
резервный адрес почты, если вы его указа: the backup e-mail address, if you gave one;
счётчик неудачных попыток входа, чтобы п: a counter of failed sign-in attempts, so that the password cannot be guessed.
Адрес в сети (IP), с которого вы подключ: The network (IP) address you connect from is not saved in the account database. It gets into the server’s technical logs: web server logs are kept for 14 days, the others are erased as the space set aside for them fills up.
Письма вашего ящика и адреса для сайтов: The letters in your mailbox and your addresses for sites are kept on our mail server in Finland: without that, mail could not be received or shown to you on different devices.
Мы не читаем письма, не анализируем их и: We do not read letters, analyse them or show ads based on them. Only those who maintain the server have access to it.
Письма, зашифрованные OpenPGP, лежат на: Letters encrypted with OpenPGP stay encrypted on the server. The private key is kept on the server only in a form encrypted on your device. The public key is published so that people can write to you encrypted.
Когда вы отправляете письмо, оно уходит: When you send a letter, it goes to the recipient’s mail server. What happens to it next is decided by that server’s rules.
Если вы подключили в Tabora ящик другой: If you connect a mailbox of another mail service to Tabora, the browser talks to that service directly from your device. The password of such a mailbox is kept in the encrypted vault on the device.
Синхронизация переносит между вашими уст: Sync carries between your devices passwords, sign-in codes, passkeys, bookmarks, spaces, open tabs, the history of the last 60 days, addresses for filling in forms, bank cards, settings and the list of extensions.
Каждая запись шифруется на устройстве кл: Every record is encrypted on the device with a key the server does not have. The server keeps the encrypted records and sees only the kind of data (for example, “passwords”), the number of records, their size and the time they changed.
Для банковских карт синхронизируются ном: For bank cards, the number, the expiry date and the holder’s name are synced. The code on the back of the card is not saved anywhere. Any group of data can be turned off in the sync settings.
Секретная фраза и ключи кошелька хранятс: The recovery phrase and the wallet keys are kept only on your device, in the encrypted vault. They never reach our server, and we cannot restore them for you.
Чтобы показать баланс и отправить перево: To show a balance and send a transfer, the wallet talks to public network nodes: PublicNode, LlamaRPC, Ankr, TronGrid, mempool.space and the nodes of Base, Polygon and Solana. They see your network address and the wallet addresses you ask about. The wallet takes exchange rates from CoinGecko.
Переводы в блокчейне видны всем и остают: Transfers on a blockchain are visible to everyone and stay there forever: that is how these networks work.
Что браузер запрашивает в сети сам: What the browser itself requests from the network
Некоторым частям браузера нужны данные и: Some parts of the browser need data from the network. In such requests the other side sees your network address but does not learn which sites you open.
Списки для блокировки рекламы: EasyList,: Lists for the ad blocker: EasyList, RU AdList, EasyPrivacy and Peter Lowe’s list. They are downloaded from their authors’ servers.
Tabora updates are downloaded from GitHub.
Службы Mozilla, доставшиеся от движка: с: Mozilla services inherited from the engine: lists of revoked certificates and dangerous extensions, tracking protection lists, the list of video codecs, updates of installed extensions and the service for notifications from sites. The notification service keeps a connection that carries a permanent profile number.
Службы Google: списки опасных сайтов Saf: Google services: the Safe Browsing lists of dangerous sites and the module for protected video. The OpenH264 video codec is downloaded from a Cisco server.
Поиск: запросы и подсказки при наборе ух: Search: queries and suggestions as you type go to the search engine chosen in the settings. In private windows suggestions are off.
Проверка утечек паролей работает, только: The breach check of passwords runs only when you press its button. The first five characters of a password’s fingerprint go to the Have I Been Pwned service: the password cannot be recovered from them.
Агент работает, только если вы добавили: The agent works only if you have added your own OpenAI key. Then your task and the contents of the pages the agent works with go to OpenAI under your key.
Обращения на support.tabora.app хранятся: Requests at support.tabora.app are kept unencrypted: support staff read them in order to answer you. If you write without an account, we keep the e-mail address you gave and send it a link to the request.
На сайте tabora.app нет счётчиков посеще: The tabora.app site has no visit counters and no ad networks.
Мы пользуемся услугами трёх компаний. He: We use the services of three companies. Hetzner provides the server in Finland. GitHub holds the source code and the updates. Requests to the tabora.app site and to the account server pass through the Cloudflare network: sign-in, sync and, in the Android app, mail as well.
Cloudflare видит ваш адрес в сети и може: Cloudflare sees your network address and can see the contents of these requests. Sync data is already encrypted on the device by then. Mail programs, the web version of mail and the support site connect to our server directly.
Мы не продаём данные и не передаём их дл: We do not sell data or hand it over for advertising. We can disclose data to authorities only on a demand that is binding by law. We cannot decrypt encrypted data.
Сколько хранятся данные и как их удалить: How long data is kept and how to delete it
Данные аккаунта хранятся, пока существуе: Account data is kept for as long as the account exists. You can delete the account in the browser (Settings, the “Account” section, the “Sign out” tab), in the web version of mail at app.tabora.app (account settings) and in the Android app (the account screen). You will need the password and, with two-step protection, the code as well.
Удаление происходит сразу. Стираются поч: Deletion happens at once. The mailbox with all its letters, the addresses for sites, the sync data, the support requests and all device sessions are erased. The address is never given to anyone else: for that we keep only the names of the address and of its addresses for sites.
В резервных копиях сервера удалённые дан: In the server’s backups deleted data can remain for up to six months, after which it is erased there too. What is saved on your devices stays on them until you remove the profile or the app.
Если пароль забыт, сначала сбросьте его: If you have forgotten the password, first reset it through the backup e-mail address and then delete the account. If that is not possible, write to support.
Ваши права и как с нами связаться: Your rights and how to reach us
Вы можете получить копию своих данных, и: You can get a copy of your data, correct it, delete it or object to its processing. Your letters and other data are available to you in the Tabora apps.
По любому вопросу пишите на <a href=\"ma: With any question, write to hello@tabora.app or through the support site. If the answer does not satisfy you, you have the right to turn to your country’s data protection authority.
Tabora предназначена для людей от 18 лет: Tabora is meant for people aged 18 and over. We do not knowingly collect children’s data.
Новая редакция публикуется на этой стран: A new version is published on this page with its date. We will tell you about significant changes by a letter to your Tabora address.
